title: Multi-Environment POMDPs with Finite-Horizon Objectives
abstract: arXiv:2605.07537v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) are systems in which one agent interacts with a stochastic environment, and receives only partial information about the current state. In a multi-environment POMDP (MEPOMDP), the initial state is unknown, and assumed to be adversarially chosen. In this work we focus on computing the optimal value and policy in MEPOMDPs with finite-horizon objectives. That problem is known to be PSPACE-complete in POMDPs. The extension is nontrivial: MEPOMDPs require reasoning about beliefs and payoffs across environments, and deterministic policies are no longer enough for optimal payoff. While the lower bound transfers immediately, the upper bound requires new techniques: we prove that mixtures of at most $n$ deterministic policies suffice for $n$ environments and show how to explore them without storing exponential-size policy descriptions. translated_title: 具有有限时域目标的多环境部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程
translated_abstract: 部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）是指单个智能体与一个随机环境进行交互、且仅能获得当前状态部分信息的系统。在多环境POMDP（MEPOMDP）中，初始状态是未知的，并被假设为以对抗方式选取。在本工作中，我们专注于计算具有有限时域目标的MEPOMDP中的最优值与最优策略。该问题在POMDP中已知是PSPACE完全的。这一扩展并非平凡：MEPOMDP需要跨环境地对信念和收益进行推理，且确定性策略不再足以获得最优收益。虽然下界可以直接传递，但上界的证明需要新的技术：我们证明了对于n个环境，最多n个确定性策略的混合即可满足最优性要求，并展示了如何在不必存储指数级规模策略描述的情况下探索这些混合策略。我们的主要结果如下：(1) 我们建立了……
tldr: 本文针对具有有限时域目标的多环境POMDP，证明了最多n个确定性策略的混合即可覆盖n个环境下的最优策略，并提出了无需存储指数级规模策略描述即可计算最优值与最优策略的新方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that mixtures of at most n deterministic policies suffice for optimal play across n environments in finite-horizon multi-environment POMDPs, and introduces new techniques to compute optimal values and policies without storing exponential-size policy descriptions.
